notes.title: Ultimate Bumper Cars: Dodgems is coming soon!
notes.content: Ultimate Bumper Cars is probably the worldwide first realistic Bumper Cars Simulator with online multiplayer support and singleplayer mode with 16 intelligent AI Drivers! Choose between Arcade or Simulation and eliminate your rivals! Impress your fans and collect extra points to unlock cars and drivers!  No other ride can compete with Dodgem Bumper Cars when it comes to family fun and entertainment.
